body:
## Context
Resolves #773.
`verifyPath` in `packages/skill-rot/lib/verify-claims.mjs` resolves `../` path claims against `repoRoot` and `skillDir` and probes `existsSync` without checking whether the resolved target stays within `repoRoot` or `skillDir`, turning public CI logs into a filesystem-existence oracle for out-of-tree paths.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Check path containment in `packages/skill-rot/lib/verify-claims.mjs` after resolving against `repoRoot` and `skillDir` (including realpath containment when the target exists).
- Classify path claims that resolve outside both `repoRoot` and `skillDir` as `unverifiable` with reason `outside repository` without probing external filesystem existence as `ok` or `stale`.

## Verify
`node --test packages/skill-rot/test/skill-rot.test.mjs`
title: skill-rot: enforce repository containment for path claims (#773)
